evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion

criteria.label: Avoiding the personal spotlight
criteria.definition: Disliking being the center versus actively centering attention on oneself.
criteria.high_evidence: Dislikes personal spotlight and generally lets attention rest elsewhere.
criteria.low_evidence: Likes or creates a personal center of attention.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Social fear N4, low assertiveness E3 and dislike of crowds E2 are not sufficient. Confident participation may coexist with high modesty here.

criteria.label: Disliking self-focused conversation
criteria.definition: Dislike versus enjoyment of talking about oneself.
criteria.high_evidence: Dislikes making own life the subject of conversation.
criteria.low_evidence: Enjoys talking about own experiences or background.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Privacy rules alone or silence imposed by others is ambiguous. The item is not limited to boastful content; neutral self-talk remains relevant.

criteria.label: Ordinary versus elevated self-appraisal
criteria.definition: Average self-view versus superiority and a high opinion of oneself.
criteria.high_evidence: Regards self as average or on a level with ordinary people.
criteria.low_evidence: Believes self better than others or thinks particularly highly of own qualities.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Actual competence is not determined. Negative self-hatred is N3-related; do not require it. A high opinion without explicit superiority remains literal keyed low content, despite self-esteem overlap.

criteria.label: Restraint in self-praise
criteria.definition: Seldom self-promoting versus boasting about virtues.
criteria.high_evidence: Rarely advertises merits or toots own horn.
criteria.low_evidence: Boasts about virtues, qualities or accomplishments.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Accurate requested factual disclosure is ambiguous without a self-promoting tendency. Boasting can be coherent and civil; do not confuse it with actual task failure.

criteria.label: Claimed breadth of known answers
criteria.definition: Limited versus broad claimed stock of known answers, retained from the reverse-keyed knowledge item.
criteria.high_evidence: Says they do not know answers to many questions or have a limited stock.
criteria.low_evidence: Says they know answers to many questions across subjects.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. An awkward knowledge/self-presentation overlap retained explicitly. Score the self-claim, never infer objective ignorance/intelligence, global incompetence, superiority or boastfulness from it. Skill in one domain alone may not establish broad knowledge.

boundary_controls.definition: Coherent unfavorable portrayed behavior is not actual experimental instruction failure or severe incoherence.
External constraint or imposed role alone is ambiguous; explicit habitual target evidence can coexist.

Modest self-presentation is not incompetence or self-hatred. The official reverse-keyed knowledge item and positive-self-opinion items are retained with explicit self-claim/esteem ambiguity, not rewritten as boasting only.
Do not replace target evidence with moral worth, politeness, helpfulness or verbosity.
